comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Quest name: Omen-bringing Bird (Chrono Quest - 4th period, 17th Century)
Quest location: Marseille Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Ecological Research, r8 Biology, ENG(English)
Pre-requisite discovery: Norwegian Forest Cat discovery (from "Was the Mythology Created First?" quest)

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Weird that this quest still hasn't been added into ivyro yet

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: That is because this quest is pretty recent in Maris. Lost Memories quests still not added yet, for example "Panama Odor Incident" and "Fisherman's Mermaid Legend". They only added those discoveries in ivyro for now.

comments.author: RangerB
comments.body:
The quest Omen-bringing birds is still not listed, but the steps are:

1. Marseille Scholar x2
2. London Barkeep x1
3. London Scholar x3
4. Use observe as you are on the bridge going toward the palace after the guilds. The discovery is on the right at the short pillar as you come off the bridge on the palace side.
